evidence_level.justification: The study is a preregistered, single-execution numerical screening of a design space: collisionless prescribed-field test-particle electron orbits (orbit_mc 1.7, numpy CPU) launched at the midpoints of the separatrix-bounded catalogue cells of every one of the 96 accepted geometry-sweep-v2 designs, in the linear-vacuum L1a equivalent-current fields re-solved on the CPU with identity proven against the sealed sweep record and a refined re-solve for every design, plus one launch-design row on the P2-qualified field of the wall-loss campaign. Its recorded outcome is an accepted screening dataset (campaign status accepted_screening_dataset): per-cell wall-access, reflection, escape and timeout fractions with Wilson intervals and floors, a frozen two-stage allocation replayed by code, a paired N -> 2N control, declared design averages, a pooled comparison with the fixed-fraction screening and a coupling-consumer record. The framework admits accepted numerical evidence through a typed committed manifest, hashed artifacts at a resolvable revision, exact registered claim text and generated artifacts with provenance sidecars; that pattern is applied here through the numerical-screening gate GATE-WALL-LOSS-GEOMETRY-SCREENING-V2 at the recorded outcome accepted-screening-dataset, the outcome of the fixed-fraction screening, reused. The sweep fields are L1a screening fields and not P2-qualified, so nothing here is accepted physical-orbit evidence of the kind admitted by GATE-WALL-LOSS-V4, and the P2 row is a launch-design variant, not a replication of that evidence; every per-cell value is a collisionless geometric wall-access fraction and never a loss probability. It is not the L1 field-resolved reduction of GATE-L1 (no manufactured solution, no L0 mapping, no performance model), not L2 and not L3, and it opens none of those gates. The results manifest was published post hoc after the locked attempt failed at publication; the disclosure is bound and verified against the bundle.
evidence_level.name: numerical-screening

relation_to_levels.L2: not coupled to any plasma model; the coupling handoffs are consumed by a verifying consumer, not by a plasma network

recorded_outcome_justification: The numerical-screening outcome accepted-screening-dataset names a collisionless test-particle wall-loss dataset integrated in L1a linear-vacuum screening fields over a design space, accepted as surrogate and optimisation input only when carried with its label; it was added for the fixed-fraction screening v1. This study is the same kind of object with a different launch design (the separatrix-bounded catalogue cells, scrambled-Sobol launch sets, a frozen two-stage allocation and a paired time-step control) and one launch-design row on the P2-qualified field; its sealed status is accepted_screening_dataset. The outcome is therefore reused rather than multiplied, so that accepted keeps meaning admitted as recorded and never that a physical finding, a loss probability or a design rule is accepted.
